ooRexx Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 validation

Build target: supplied ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 Internal Test Version headers/runtime.
Native runtime, optional Python provider, Vulkan provider, tensor probe and C fixture compile cleanly with -Wall -Wextra.

v0.22.6 forcing case: ABI-native C scalar aliases
PASS ABI-native C scalar aliases 23 assertions
  - runtime ABI profile = linux-x86_64-le-lp64
  - long = i64 / 8 bytes
  - unsigned long = u64 / 8 bytes
  - size_t = u64 / 8 bytes
  - ssize_t = i64 / 8 bytes
  - ptrdiff_t = i64 / 8 bytes
  - socklen_t = u32 / 4 bytes
  - >32-bit long/size_t scalar round trips through real C functions
  - signed >32-bit ptrdiff_t/ssize_t round trips
  - ForeignStruct fields use the resolved widths and are read by native C
  - runtime advertises abi-native-c-scalars

Qualified ABI-specific profiles remain:
  linux-x86_64-le-lp64

Explicitly NOT qualified:
  linux-aarch64-le-lp64
  other Unix/Windows ABI layout/constant profiles
